messages:
alex: Heads-up: targeting Tue 09:00 PT for the v1.3 public announce. Need changelog permalink + canonical docs link by 5pm for scheduling social + newsroom card.

priya: I can draft hero copy & lead metric. Do we have a single clean percent to call out?

kate: Bench quick take: p95 web workload shows 32-38% token-cost reduction with adaptive batching + quant profiles. Suggest "up to 38%" on hero and link to full report.

alex: OK use "up to 38% on typical web workloads". Priya, add a parenthetical footnote linking to the perf appendix.

ben: Changelog PR is nearly done, holding on one migration note. Will merge in ~30m and post permalink.

deploy-bot: preview deploy queued: refs/heads/release-1.3 -> preview; build#9123.

priya: Webinar slot locked at 11:00 PT same day. Marketing needs a short CTA for the announce page: do we want "See the live demo" or stronger?

kate: "See a live demo: how we cut per-token cost" is fine. Shorten for mobile. Link should go to signup modal connected to HubSpot.

ben: merged changelog -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.3 (draft). Adding migration note for dedicated routing.

deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.ai/releases/v1.3 (expires in 7 days). screenshots available.

priya: Draft hero + subhead: "Up to 38% lower per-token costs on typical web workloads." Subhead: "Adaptive batching, quantization profiles, and smarter routing reduce unit economics without changing prompts." Will share social drafts.

alex: Need canonical docs link for blog header and newsroom card before 5pm. Kate, can you publish the doc redirect?

kate: Done: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/1.3 and canonical landing at https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3. Added anchors for batching examples.

priya: Social copy draft: "Were releasing v1.3: adaptive batching, lower token costs, and easier migration. Read the notes -> <docs link>. Join the live demo Wed 11:00 PT: <webinar link>."

ben: Ops note: canary rollout Fri 09:00 PT. Command: `deployctl rollout start --tag=v1.3 --canary=10% --watch`. Fallback: route to v1.2 for 2h if p95 latency regresses >10%.

alex: Perfect. Priya, schedule the announce at 09:00 PT; webinar invite at 11:00 PT. Use preview screenshots for social cards.

priya: Will schedule if we stay green on the checklist: changelog (ben), docs (kate), preview (deploy-bot), webinar (kate), hero copy (priya).

kate: Uploaded screenshots and short demo deck to drive.

ben: Final links: changelog https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.3, docs https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3, perf report https://docs.redwood.ai/reports/batching-v1.3.

alex: Thanks everyone  I'll post the scheduled publish URLs here once queued. If any rollback or deploy delays, flag in this thread. :rocket:
